methods.name: new
methods.behaviour: calls initialize() so no object is used before it has known values

methods.name: initialize
methods.behaviour: operand_A = 0, operand_B = 0, alu_op = OP_SEL_B, alu_result = 0. Virtual so arithmetic_alu can also clear carry and CPU.Reset() reaches it through one call

methods.name: display
methods.behaviour: prints one line: [<class>] op=<alu_op.name()> A=<%0d> B=<%0d> result=<%0d>

methods.name: get_name
methods.behaviour: returns "base_alu"; overridden so display() prints the real class name

methods.name: execute
methods.behaviour: base class has no operations: reports $error and leaves alu_result unchanged

spec_text.FR-001: Define a base_alu class that provides the common properties and methods used by the ALU classes.
spec_text.FR-002: Provide load_operand_A to load/store operand A.
spec_text.FR-003: Provide load_operand_B to load/store operand B.
spec_text.FR-004: Provide an initialize method for the base_alu class.
spec_text.FR-005: Provide a display method in base_alu.
spec_text.D-007: initialize() sets operand_A = 0, operand_B = 0, alu_op = OP_SEL_B, alu_result = 0 (and carry = 0 in arithmetic_alu). new() calls initialize().
spec_text.D-010: display() prints one line: [<class>] op=<op.name()> A=<%0d> B=<%0d> result=<%0d> (arithmetic_alu adds  carry=<0/1>).
spec_text.D-011: function void load_operand_A(int value), function void load_operand_B(int value), function void initialize(), function void display().
spec_text.D-012: function int Calc(int in1, int in2, alu_op_t operation). Codes 0000-0110 go to a_alu, 0111-1101 to l_alu. Calc loads operands and op into that ALU, calls its execute(), returns its alu_result.
spec_text.D-018: CPU.new() constructs l_alu and a_alu; base_alu.new() calls initialize(), so no object is ever used uninitialised.
